evals.prompt: This session the parent agent claimed tests passed without running them, then a subagent edited the generated AGENTS.md loadout block. Project AGENTS.md matches evals/files/agents-no-learnings.md (no Learnings section). User: /learn
evals.expected_output: Concise mistake list including the parent and the subagent, then create ## Learnings in AGENTS.md with a preamble and numbered high-confidence rules. Do not edit the generated loadout block.
expectations: Lists obvious mistakes from the parent agent and the subagent
Creates a ## Learnings section because none exists
Adds a preamble that these are dynamic learnings an agent should consider
Writes a numbered list of short project-level rules
Does not edit content inside the generated loadout markers

evals.prompt: Same session mistakes as eval 1. Project AGENTS.md matches evals/files/agents-with-learnings.md (existing Learnings already include run tests before claiming done). User: /learn
evals.expected_output: Mistake list, then merge into the existing Learnings list: keep or improve the test-claim rule, add a generated-block rule, dedupe, keep numbering.
expectations: Merges into the existing ## Learnings section instead of appending a second section
Dedupes or improves the existing test-command rule rather than duplicating it
Adds a new high-confidence rule for the generated-block mistake if missing
Leaves unrelated existing learnings in place

evals.prompt: Clean session: the agent followed the plan, ran tests, and made no obvious mistakes. Project AGENTS.md matches evals/files/agents-with-learnings.md. User: /learn
evals.expected_output: No obvious agent or subagent mistakes. Leave AGENTS.md Learnings unchanged. Do not invent rules.
expectations: Says there were no obvious mistakes
Does not invent mistakes or speculative rules

evals.prompt: Mid-implementation the user says that last patch was a mistake, keep going. Do not run /learn.
expectations: Does not trigger on a passing mention of a mistake
Triggers only on /learn or an explicit ask to capture session mistakes as AGENTS.md learnings
